QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Lost Meaning
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the rest of Elpam's story.
QuestInfo.1: From what Elpam was able to interpret, Naricain's followers seem to be searching for Antellion. Return to Jack and tell him of this new finding.
QuestInfo.2: You told Jack about what you've learned so far.

npc.0: If you translate it literally, Noille Nalle means 'Star of Night'. It's the accursed artifact that brought immense pain to the Versalians. You're probably already familiar with it, in fact... Please, tell your friend about it.
